# Map - Harbor

- [Anchor](#anchor): holds the ship

## Anchor

An anchor is held by a [chain link](#chain) and marked by a [Buoy](#buoy).
See also Lighthouse and Missing note.

### Details

Heavier than the [Hook](#anchor) suggests.
